verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Recurly emits webhooks for subscription events, which Recurly Engage consumes for real-time updates. Credit invoices also carry webhook notifications. Nothing in the pack lists which lifecycle events fire, so coverage of every change in the story cannot be confirmed. missing for 10: documented event types for renewal, upgrade, payment failure and cancellation, delivery reliability guarantees (retries, ordering, signing/verification), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, every subscription state change — renewal, upgrade, payment failure, cancellation — emits a webhook or event my systems can act on reliably

citations.quote: integrating your Recurly account with our system using webhooks to enable real-time updates for subscription events
each credit gets a clean record with a clear origin, full audit trail, and webhook notifications
